name: Token
overview: The Bible presents tokens as divinely appointed signs that confirm God's covenant and authority. For example, God established the sun and moon as tokens to mark time and seasons (Genesis 1:14), and He set a mark on Cain as a protective sign (Genesis 4:15). The rainbow serves as a perpetual token of God's covenant never to destroy the earth by flood (Genesis 9:12-15). These tokens underscore God's faithfulness and sovereign control over creation and human history.
